original_test_intent: Verify that Enter activates one specified safe BIOS Setup selection and produces its expected menu/submenu response without changing configuration.
original_method: Bind host/console and a non-mutating menu path/item, approve one setup-entry window, capture focus before Enter, have the operator press Enter once, capture the exact response, then exit without saving and confirm normal boot.
manual_activity: Human operator must navigate to and visibly confirm the approved non-mutating item, press Enter once, judge the expected response and exit without saving.
required_inputs: BIOS menu path and safe selected item
Physical or validated remote pre-OS input/capture
safety_requirements: Stop on unexpected activation or recovery failure
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify host/console and supplied item reference
Report without claiming key action or final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve safe item and reboot window

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states ordinary SSH cannot prove an Enter-driven BIOS menu response.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the operator-driven Select test on one owner-approved non-mutating item through a physical or validated console.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Enter selection and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture focused item immediately before Enter, the one key actuation, exact resulting page/state and no-save exit in a continuous sequence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a safe target and objective response oracle.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An unspecified focused item can execute a state-changing or reset action.

project_override_considerations: Project must name a reversible/non-mutating item and expected response; a generic Enter demonstration without focus evidence is not acceptable.
expected_evidence: Approved menu path/item and response reference
Single Enter and resulting submenu/selection response

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently request BIOS Select/Enter behavior; the missing target is a necessary project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual key purpose is clear; a safe item, console/operator and recovery path are finite readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic or dangerous Enter press by requiring a named non-mutating item, focused-state proof and no-save recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Enter behavior is defined by the focused BIOS UI item and must be judged visually. Automation cannot establish or safely actuate that context through ordinary SSH, so MANUAL ONLY remains correct.
